resolutions.researcher_notes: Recorded value Status='proposed'. The dead current_ref (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t2198317.shtml, the 2019 Guangxi DRC approval notice) has NO web.archive.org snapshot (checked CDX API for the exact URL and for the domain generally — no capture of this page exists), so it cannot be recovered. Fresh Chinese-language search found no other source that supports 'proposed' as the CURRENT status; on the contrary, two independent-stage 2025-07-30 and 2026-07-23 government-mandated post-construction environmental filings by the builder (Guangxi Gas Group / 广西燃气集团有限公司, via yanshougs.com) describe this exact named project as built/construction-complete, i.e. they support a status change to 'operating', not 'proposed'. Per the never-propose-a-different-value rule, not citing those filings here — this is an existing sheet-value disagreement, already flagged for the Update workflow in the prior deep-sweep audit shard (rows/P7658.json status_reviews entry, recommending Status -> operating, StartYear1 2025, tier medium since both filings trace to one builder's sequential regulatory submissions). Leaving UNRESOLVED rather than fabricating support for the stale 'proposed' value.

Recorded ProposalYear=2019 / ProposalMonth=10. Same dead current_ref as Status (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t2198317.shtml) with no wayback snapshot (CDX API empty for this URL). Searched for the underlying Guangxi DRC approval notice republished elsewhere (web search for the project name plus 核准/批复, and for the Guangxi Gas Group tender platform gigeps.com) and for a sibling notice in the same 2019 approval batch (found the parallel 陆川天然气支线管道 approval, 桂发改能源〔2019〕480号-series, confirming this WAS a real 2019 provincial approval round for the Guangxi branch-network program, but did not turn up the Binyang-specific notice or its month). The two 2025/2026 completion filings (yanshougs.com/content/107398.html, /110210.html) do not state a project-approval date. No independent source found that states 2019-10 specifically for this segment; UNRESOLVED rather than citing a source that doesn't actually contain the month.

Recorded Capacity=0.29 bcm/y. Both independent, dated (2025-07-30 and 2026-07-23) government-mandated environmental completion filings for this exact named project state design throughput '设计输量2.91×10^8 Nm3/a' = 0.291 bcm/y, matching the recorded value. Filed by the builder (Guangxi Gas Group) at two separate regulatory stages 11 months apart; not GEM/gem.wiki/abarrelfull.
Recorded Pressure=4 MPa. Both filings state '设计压力4MPa' exactly, matching the recorded value. Same two independently dated builder regulatory filings as above.

Recorded LengthKnown=27 km. The dead current_ref has no wayback snapshot. The two 2025/2026 completion filings, which are otherwise strong independent corroboration for this project, give the AS-BUILT length as 23.9196 km and 23.925 km respectively — about 3 km / 11% shorter than the recorded 27 km, most likely the gap between the 2019 pre-construction/proposal estimate and the realized as-built figure. Per the never-propose-a-different-value rule, not citing these filings as support for '27 km'; this is a value disagreement, already flagged in the prior deep-sweep audit (rows/P7658.json validity entry recommending LengthKnown be corrected to ~23.9-23.925 km). No source found that supports 27 km specifically. UNRESOLVED.
Recorded Diameter=273.1 mm. Both filings state '管径D273.1mm' (L290 ERW steel pipe), matching the recorded value exactly. Same two independently dated builder regulatory filings.

Recorded Start/EndLocation=Binyang, Nanning, Guangxi, China (both ends). The 2025-07-30 filing states the route runs from the existing Leitang (黎塘) distribution station (built for Sinopec's Guangxi LNG project) west through Leitang/Yangqiao/Wangling/Daqiao townships to the Binyang distribution station near Tangbiao village, northeast of Binyang town -- all within Binyang County, Nanning, Guangxi, matching the recorded Binyang/Nanning/Guangxi/China location on both ends. Confirmed present in both filings' project-name header ('宾阳天然气支线管道').

Recorded SegmentCost=131,020,000 RMB (2019). The dead current_ref has no wayback snapshot. The two completion filings give investment figures for this project but neither matches: EIA-stage estimated total investment '环评阶段总投资为12643万元' = 126,430,000 RMB, and actual realized total investment '实际总投资为10500万元' = 105,000,000 RMB -- both differ from the recorded 131,020,000 RMB (closest is the EIA estimate, still ~3.6% off, and neither is an approval-stage/立项批复 figure). Searched web for the original 2019 Guangxi DRC approval notice or a republication of its investment figure (project name + 核准/批复/投资); found the parallel same-batch 陆川天然气支线管道 approval notice confirming the 2019 approval round exists but not a Binyang-specific figure. Per the never-propose-a-different-value rule, not citing the filings as support for 131,020,000 RMB since neither states that number. UNRESOLVED.
